fact: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology launched, in pilot and gradual roll-out, the Digital Identity biometric verification system, matching a user's face against Civil Status Sector records and issuing an instant e-signature certificate through licensed providers, open to the four licensed mobile operators.
title: الاتصالات تطلق «الهوية الرقمية» لإنجاز خدمات المحمول والتحقق من الهوية عن بُعد
